# The EVTasker catalogue

Every condition a rule can test and every action it can run, straight out of `ConditionType` and `ActionType`. *Firmware* is what the entry is annotated for; "any" means it depends on no vehicle firmware at all, not that it needs nothing — a notification still needs the permission, a call still needs a paired phone. The car's own Diagnostic screen stays the only answer for the car in front of you.
